description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, including registration and login, using FastAPI framework with database interactions via SQLAlchemy and security functions for password hashing and token creation.

methods.name: UserOut register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user record with hashed password after verifying non-existence.

methods.name: TokenResponse login_user(payload: LoginRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles user authentication, verifies credentials, and generates an access token.
